title: Schema Model Extends
description: A model that extends a template (`*.template.json`). The template supplies the model body; this file holds the identity fields, the template parameters and any differences. Full validation runs on the resolved model.

select_exclude.description: Inherited select items to remove: a column name, or `<type>:<ref>` for a bulk select (for example `dims_from_cte:monthly`).

ctes_exclude.description: Names of inherited CTEs to remove.

select_mode.description: `merge` (default) merges `select` into the template's by identity; `replace` uses this `select` as-is.

ctes_mode.description: `merge` (default) merges `ctes` into the template's by name; `replace` uses these `ctes` as-is.
